What happens to sensitive media I report?

>x< reviews reports of media flagged by users to determine if that media requires a warning message in order to comply with >x<’s media policies. Please remember that by flagging media you are bringing it to the attention of the >x< team. The flagged content will not automatically receive a warning message or be removed from the site.
